verdict: Borderline component with embedded sort + verdict-classification logic. HIGH-6 lex sort fix (compareIntraSectionMembers exported + tested with 9 cases including operator scenario) is correctly implemented. cannibalization risk sort (lines 277-294) uses `order` Record keyed by risk enum — extensible and correct, including post-fix `composition_changed` exclusion from alerts (surfaced separately as info banner). 1 MEDIUM finding: crossSection sort silently treats missing metrics as 0 (asymmetric with intraSection which sinks them to bottom via compareIntraSectionMembers). 1 LOW finding: `currentRankIntra >= intraCount` weakest threshold (lines 356-358) uses `intraCount >= 3` — matches `applyCohortAdjustmentOnce` floor per JSDoc but the constant is duplicated.

findings.failing_input: Cross-platform cohort where a member has `metrics === undefined` (still-loading SWR fetch or upstream error)
findings.expected: Missing-metrics members sink to the bottom (same behavior as compareIntraSectionMembers' explicit null handling)
findings.actual: `sa = a.metrics ? a.metrics.roasShopify : 0` and `sb = b.metrics ? b.metrics.roasShopify : 0` — a missing-metrics member is treated as roasShopify=0 and competes with legitimately-zero-ROAS members. With 2 members both missing, undefined sort order. With 1 missing + 1 legit-zero, the missing one may rank above or below depending on stable-sort behavior.
findings.fix_sketch: Reuse compareIntraSectionMembers for crossSection (same lex contract; both sections want best-first with missing sunk). Or inline an explicit `if (!a.metrics && !b.metrics) return 0; if (!a.metrics) return 1; if (!b.metrics) return -1;` guard at the top of the crossSection comparator.
findings.regression_test_idea: Add test case: `cohort.crossPlatformOthers = [{...withMetrics, roasShopify:0}, {...missingMetrics}]` → sorted result must place the missing one last. Pair with `[{...missing}, {...missing}]` returning order-preserving (comparator returns 0).

findings.failing_input: Cohort with 3 intra-platform members where current ranks #3 (last)
findings.expected: Magic constant `3` (the cohort-size floor for 'weakest' visual treatment) should be sourced from a shared constant alongside applyCohortAdjustmentOnce's floor, so the two stay in lock-step
findings.actual: `intraCount >= 3` is hardcoded both here AND in lib/campaignHealthScore.ts:applyCohortAdjustmentOnce. JSDoc cross-references but no compile-time link.
findings.fix_sketch: Export `COHORT_WEAKEST_FLOOR = 3` from lib/campaignHealthScore.ts; import here. One-line change preserves behavior, prevents silent drift.
findings.regression_test_idea: Already covered indirectly by HI-02 (cohort-adjustment floor) tests in campaignHealthScore.test.ts; no new UI test needed.

findings.expected: Either guaranteed-finite by upstream contract OR explicit handling

findings.fix_sketch: Defensive — leave as-is or add an assertion log if it fires.
